# Whole-read continuation: audited failure checkpoint

The intended transport negative was accepted. The positive mandatory whole-read consumer timed out and is unaccepted. Neither phase produced a verified artifact. The frozen preparation README and candidate metadata retain their historical NOT_RUN status; this document and results.json record the subsequent actual outcomes.

Both phases supplied 22 inputs, including 18 source modules. Official source checks admitted all 18. The negative verification exited 1 with LLV7002 after 203,247 ms aggregate: the unrelated 0 = 0 theorem did not establish the required zero-case goal in ObjectWholeReadTransport. This does not establish elaboration or conversion of the selected whole-read consumer.

The positive verification exited 4 with LLS8002. The final ObjectWholeReadContinuation Lean child reached 300,004 ms against its unchanged 300,000 ms limit; aggregate verification lasted 400,487 ms. Post-run memory events recorded max = 450159, with oom = 0 and oom_kill = 0. The memory guard failed. Source, development lock, tools, epoch, idle and both storage postchecks passed. This is a timeout with recorded memory-limit pressure, not semantic falsity or an OOM kill. The existing zero-event gate would reject new compute in this resource epoch.

The exact independent [negative review](evidence/negative-native-review.json) and [failure review](evidence/failure-native-review.json) include complete 49-file raw censuses for each phase. Selected raw receipts and genuine development locks are retained here; omitted per-input copy and setup receipts remain in their original external evidence paths. No compiled binaries or invented production locks are included. Discrete resource observations are samples, not measured peaks or causal explanations.

The original digest investigation falsely reported no reusable exact input. Its [original report](evidence/next-whole-digest-investigation.json) and [CHANGES_REQUIRED review](evidence/next-whole-digest-spec-conditional.json) are preserved unchanged. A separate source-only correction identifies the accepted Direct09 theorem; it does not accept this failed whole-read bridge or authorize a retry.

Actual whole-read continuation, complete whole-read success and original ordinal 26/Read33 remain open, as do the ten remaining drafts and full Object, Hash, PrismPM and Pages integration. Prior accepted admitted-range and concrete-finish results retain their narrower scopes.
